title: 5.3.1 Under IPC crimes A total of 59,345 juvenile crimes were recorded in the country during 1982 under IPC cognizable crimes as against 61,019 in the year 1981. The incidence in different States and Union Territories varied widely and it has no relationship with the area or population of the States and Union Territories. The four States viz.
